gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Soundcore Liberty 4 NC lasts about 5 hours per charge with LDAC and ANC both on. Digital Trends got that figure in its own test, which is roughly half of SoundGuys' 9 h 53 min ANC-on figure (codec not stated) that ChatGPT repeated as "nearly 10 hours measured".
standout_why: I compared against SoundGuys' best-earbuds-under-$100 page (cited, 2026-10-15), Skimwire's budget-ANC page (cited, 2026-10-24) and SoundGuys' best-LDAC page (cited, dated 2025-11-06). All three give per-product battery only from SoundGuys' standard test, which never names the codec. That includes Liberty 4 NC 9 h 53 min, Air Pro 4+ 6 h 17 min, Capsule3 Pro+ 3 h 53 min and CMF Buds 2 Plus 10 h 22 min. None gives a battery figure measured with LDAC on, or says LDAC shortens runtime, for any candidate. All three already carry SoundGuys' ANC percentages (84%, 83%, 80%), so ANC adds nothing new.
decides: For an LDAC buyer this removes battery as a reason to pick the Liberty 4 NC. ChatGPT made it the 'best ANC and battery' pick on the strength of the ~10 h figure. With LDAC and ANC on it measured about 5 h. That is close to the 5 h 48 min one reviewer measured for the EarFun Air Pro 4+ on LDAC. The Liberty 4 NC stays the ANC pick: SoundGuys measured 84% vs 80% for the Air Pro 4+. On battery under LDAC, though, the two are roughly level, and the Air Pro 4+'s sound and codec advantages decide it. Our own table's '9.85 h' Liberty 4 NC cell needs an LDAC caveat.
